decided.headline: Senior Data Analyst
decided.reasoning: Strong content match: stakeholder-facing BI/analytics role partnering with Finance, Product, Sales and Content teams, building dashboards and data models -- closely tracks Samuel's consulting background (star schema modeling, Tableau/Power BI/Looker dashboard development, translating stakeholder questions into technical requirements). The ad's call for 'experience accelerating analytics development using AI tools such as Cursor or Claude' matches his listed Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT experience directly.
decided.gaps: dbt is named as a core required skill ('Strong SQL and dbt skills') and doesn't appear anywhere in the CV. Omni, the specific BI tool named, also isn't listed -- his BI tool experience is Tableau/Power BI/Looker, which is transferable but not the same tool. Role is titled 'Senior' with no explicit seniority/years-of-experience stated in the CV. Location is Stockholm on-site; the ad mentions the company has remote teams generally but doesn't confirm this specific role is remote/hybrid.
